checks.method: Read MinimumTransversals.lean and ProfileASplit.lean, derive the support-count argument, and run scratch/alpha/round07_transversals.py over all3003 six-subsets of two canonical six-point supports plus two foreign points.
checks.observation: The formal theorem fixes both designs before choosing a transversal. Each support trace must have at least three points; disjointness and total size six force exactly three on each side and no foreign points. A three-point transversal is a design member: the ten intersecting blocks select exactly one from each complementary pair of triples, so any nonblock triple has a disjoint block complement. The finite check finds exactly100 six-point transversals, all unions of one block per fixed design, with zero foreign-point cases. ProfileASplit constructs one DesignPair and applies this same pair to every completion; it does not silently select different components per row.
checks.scope: Synchronized minimum transversals and outsider/moving-component counterexamples

checks.method: Independently reconstruct the new prose argument for a singleton exact-trace class at v∈R, including distinctness and common-core conditions.
checks.observation: Deleting v from class members is injective and gives triples outside R. Two disjoint residues lift to two original members whose mutual intersection is{v}, also their intersection with R; all three members are distinct because their traces on R are respectively one and four points. Three sunflower residues likewise lift by adding v to the core. Thus the residues are intersecting and sunflower-free, supporting the inherited cap ten without an unmentioned assumption.
checks.scope: Singleton exact-trace lift after Section4 clarification

content.summary: The strongest remaining missing-lift concern—whether each completion might use a different design decomposition or an outsider-containing minimum transversal—is excluded by the fixed DesignPair and synchronized transversal theorem. A separate check confirms the newly expanded singleton-trace explanation produces distinct original-family sunflower members. No open mathematical objection remains from these tests.
